FC Union Berlin will host 1. FC Köln on Sunday afternoon, though this time in the league. Kick off at the Stadion An der Alten Försterei is at 15:30. October 31, 2026 The lie of the land 1. FC Köln are travelling to Berlin with momentum on their side, having swept Union away at home on Tuesday evening in the DFB Pokal, 5-0. Prior to that, head coach René Wagner's side earned a point in the Bundesliga against FC Schalke 04, lost to Eintracht in Frankfurt, and managed a 2-1 victory against Mönchengladbach.   Union would rather forget midweek. After a decent first half, Mauro Lustrinelli's team lost control of the match in the RheinEnergieSTADION after the break and had to concede a heavy defeat in the end. Now, they have the opportunity for revenge in front of their home crowd.  The opponents That 5-0 cup win was Köln's strongest performance of the season so far. Taking centre stage was Saïd El Mala, who, with two goals and one assist, played a significant role in the  Domstädter's advancement to the next round. He is joined by Linton Maina and Ísak Jóhannessonas an attackinng force; both joined him on the scorecard on Tuesday. Personnel Union's coaching team will have to do without Felix Uduokhai, Robert Skov, Andrej Ilić, and Stanley Nsoki on Sunday afternoon.  Voices before the game “We need to return to our DNA: to the compactness that defines us and that throughout the entire match. On Sunday, we want to show a different face. This type of defeat has hurt and annoyed us, and it requires the right reaction. We want to show from the first minute that we can do better. The time was tight, but it’s a new game and therefore a new chance,” emphasized Union’s head coach Mauro Lustrinelli in advance.  “The game will be different. Union will have a certain degree of anger and will set many objectives. They play at home and will act more boldly with the ball. They have played well at home, which they will want to build on. We need to be prepared for that,” said FC coach René Wagner.  Service information The Stadion An der Alten Försterei opens two hours before kick off, the match is sold out in both the home and away areas.         There are still extensive traffic disruptions in public transport and in the stadium vicinity. The underpass Hämmerlingstraße is closed just like the Waldweg. The footpath to the stadium leads along the sports hall.    No parking options are available in the vicinity of the stadium.   The match will be broadcast live in Germany by DAZN , with an audio stream on rbb24 Inforadio and rbb24 . Union will provide updates via their live ticker , as well as in English on Twitter. FC Union Berlin has to endure a clear defeat in the DFB Pokal, ending their cup run for 2026/27 after a 0-5 loss against 1. FC Köln. On the side of Köln, SaÏd El Mala stands out particularly with two goals (32./60.) and one assist; in addition, Linton Maina (52.), Isak Johannesson (78.), and Sebastian Sebulonsen (88.) also score. October 27, 2026 1. FC Union Berlin: Raab – Haberer, Querfeld, Van den Bosch, Rothe (46. Köhn) – Schäfer (68. Kemlein), Khedira – Jeong (75. Ljubičić), Aebischer – Gray (57. Latte Lath), Skarke (57. Burcu)  1. FC Köln: Schwäbe – Castro-Montes (64. Sebulonsen), Schmied, Simpson-Pusey, Sosa (81. Mensah) – Okon-Engstler (72. Johannesson), Krauß – Maina (72. Thielmann), Moore – Bülter, S. El Mala (81. Heskey)  Personnel: Compared to the last Bundesliga matchday, head coach Mauro Lustrinelli changed his starting eleven in three positions: Matheo Raab replaced Frederik Rönnow in goal, while Leopold Querfeld moved into defense for Felix Uduokhai. In attack, Wooyeong Jeong switched to the wing, replacing Livan Burcu and making room in the forward position for starting debutant Mekhi Gray.  Attendance: 49,000  Goals: 1-0 S. El Mala (32.), 2-0 Maina (52.), 3-0 S. El Mala (60.), 4-0 Johannesson (78.), 5-0 Sebulonson (88.)  Both teams with high effort - Cologne with the first goal. In the historically first DFB Pokal duel between both teams, especially the Eisernen started with high intensity, pressing the hosts often very high and thereby provoking the long pass or, in the best case, regaining possession of the ball. They were able to create some early chances as well, but Tim Skarke (7th) and Janik Haberer (16th) were unsuccessful on two occasions. The same applied to former Unioner Marius Bülter, who sent the first chance for FC into the arms of Rönnow's substitute Matheo Raab after 21 minutes. Four minutes later, it was again Raab's arms that prevented the deficit: he deflected Linton Maina's attempt in a one-on-one duel decisively onto the post. In the constant back and forth, just before the half-hour mark, it was again the Köpenickers who were dreaming of taking the lead through Zeno Van den Bosch, but Köln's Marvin Schwäbe reacted strongly to parry the Belgian's header. In a highly intense match until that point, the next shot on goal was, unfortunately from Union's perspective, lodged in the wrong net. A quick counterattack was finished off by Saïd El Mala from close range into the far corner (32nd). With strong timing and an even better reflex, the next duel between the goalscorer and Union's Raab would then go to the goalkeeper (43rd). Shortly thereafter, the first half ended with a score of 0-1 from the perspective of 1. FC Union Berlin. Cologne strikes early – Union fails to score. It seems there is no text provided. Please provide the German text for translation. With a visible determination to quickly equalize the deficit, the Lustrinelli team began the second half; Tim Skarke's direct shot after a Gray assist ended up in the side netting (50.). A few seconds later, however, the ball was in the net at the other end, after Linton Maina had tapped in a cross from S. El Mala with the tip of his foot (52.). Köln's national player collected his third assist of the evening eight minutes later at 3-0, when he - this time attacking from the right side - curled the ball into the far corner beyond reach. After a quieter phase without many penalty area scenes, the Eisernen had to concede the fourth goal in the 79th minute. Isak Johannesson, who had been substituted in shortly before, converted a Bülter cross in the six-yard box to make it decisive. Another FC substitute, Sebastian Sebulonsen, put the final touch to the match with his 5-0 just moments before the final whistle. Voices after the game Rani Khedira “We actually started well, but after halftime we completely lost our thread. We can only apologize to our fans for that. The attitude is there, but it was simply a poor performance. Now we have to pick ourselves up and do significantly better on Sunday,” said Rani Khedira.   Mauro Lustrinelli “The first half hour was really good. After halftime, we had many ball losses, lost focus, and for Köln, every shot was on target. For the future, we need to find solutions, and fortunately, we have a game against the same opponent in a few days,” evaluates Mauro Lustrinelli the match.  Outlook for the upcoming week   Before the second match of the week against 1. Union faces two matches against 1. FC Köln | 1. FC Union Berlin Club Club Zeughaus Zeughaus Tickets Tickets AFTV AFTV Events Events Foundation Foundation en News Football Club Fans Stadium Sponsoring More Search Mega Menu Homepage News Men's Team News Double layer against the cathedral city club: Union faces two matches against 1. FC Köln Within a few days, the paths of Union and Köln will cross twice. First in the DFB Pokal, followed by a match in The Bundesliga. For the very first time in history, both teams will face each other on Tuesday, 27.10.2026, in a cup duel. The kick off at the RheinEnergieStadion will take place at 20:45. October 26, 2026 The Situation Win, win, loss, draw, loss, win, loss, draw – that is the current record of FC in the ongoing season. In search of consistency, the Kölner had to endure two matches without scoring: both in Frankfurt (1-0) and against FC Schalke 04 (0-0), the offense was unsuccessful. The Eisernen, on the other hand, enter the match with significantly more momentum, as the team of head coach Mauro Lustrinelli secured five points in the last three games against SV Elversberg, BVB, and most recently in Augsburg. The opponent check The Kölner finished the previous season 2025/26 in fourteenth place, marking their first season back in the top flight. The most important player, at least in terms of attack, was Said El Mala with a total of 18 points. In the current season, the now twice-capped German international is still searching for his goal-scoring instincts, but with two of his own goals he only trails his teammate Ísak Jóhannesson (three goals and one assist) in the internal goalscorer list. Other pillars in the game of the Domstädter are goalkeeper Marvin Schwäbe and central defender Jahmai Simpson-Pusey, who was permanently signed after his loan in 2025/26 last summer; both have not missed a single minute on the pitch so far. The reunion On the side of FC are Marius Bülter, Cologne head coach René Wagner and assistant coach Kevin McKenna, familiar faces from Union's past, while at Union, Horst Heldt, managing director of professional football, is the one with a history at Cologne. Personal Head coach Mauro Lustrinelli and his coaching staff will have to do without Stanley Nsoki, Josip Juranović, and Andrej Ilić on Tuesday evening. Voices before the game "Our focus is on ourselves and on consistently implementing our plan on the pitch. Köln has acted from different formations in recent matches, which is why we do not want to commit to a specific style of play. What matters is that we deliver our performance and carry out our game. In the end, it's about scoring one more goal than the opponent to progress to the next round," explained Union's head coach Mauro Lustrinelli regarding the Cup match. FC head coach René Wagner expressed the following at the press conference: "What plays in our favor is that Union operates from a similar system as we do. Our main focus will be on using our chances efficiently and scoring the necessary goals. Especially in front of our home fans, we want to create the conditions to advance to the next round in the end." Service information For the away game at the Rhine, 2,400 Unioner will travel to Cologne. Information on visiting the stadium can be found on the Union homepage. The match will be broadcast live by Sky . Additionally, there is an audio stream on rbb24 Inforadio and on rbb24 , and as usual, Union will keep you updated on the match via the club's own live ticker .
